scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate -w packages/prisma && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=apps/api --workspace=apps/web --if-present
scripts.build:web: npm run db:generate -w packages/prisma && npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run db:generate -w packages/prisma && npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api
